description: A smartphone lies on a green-covered surface with a white charging cable nearby, and both hands are visible in front of it. The right hand slides in from the right and steadies the phone as a right-hand object, while the left hand reaches in from the left to pick up the cable tip and guide it to the phone’s port; the left hand inserts the connector, making the cable a left-hand object while the phone remains held by the right hand.
